name: Piburger See
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Piburger See at 911 m above Oetz is one of Tirol's warmest alpine swimming lakes, set in a protected landscape with an idyllic loop, public lido, and boat rentals.
preis: Lakeshore loop freely accessible; public bathing lido on southern shore charges summer admission
oeffnungszeiten: Lakeside trails accessible year-round; bathing beach and rowing boat hire operate May to September
beschreibung:
Überblick

The enchanting Lake Piburger See is situated at an elevation of 911 metres above the charming town of Oetz at the threshold of the sunny Ötztal Valley, celebrated as one of North Tirol's most precious natural monuments. Formed by a post-glacial rockslide that naturally dammed the ancient valley, this pristine 14-hectare lake plunges to depths of 25 metres within a secluded forested amphitheatre. Despite its genuine alpine setting, surface water temperatures climb to a delightful 24 degrees Celsius in midsummer, earning Piburger See renown as one of the warmest natural bathing lakes in the Austrian Alps. The lake and its contiguous spruce forests and wetland mosses enjoy strict nature reserve status. Dense evergreens skirt the shoreline while the jagged 3,007-metre pyramid of Mount Acherkogel towers prominently above. A timber bathing lido with sun terraces, wooden rowboat rentals, and tranquil walking trails establish the lake as a quintessential retreat for nature admirers.

Route & Anforderungen

The scenic loop trail encircling Lake Piburger See measures approximately 3.5 kilometres and is easily strolled in about one hour of leisurely walking (approx. 60 metres elevation change). The path weaves gently over soft pine-needle forest floors, wooden boardwalks, and shaded shoreline viewpoints. Hikers seeking a longer excursion can start directly from Oetz village, crossing the dramatic Wellerbrücke timber bridge over roaring whitewater rapids on the Ötztaler Ache before climbing through forest meadows to the hamlet of Piburg and the lake (approx. 2 to 2.5 hours total, 180 vertical metres). Standard sneakers or light trail shoes suffice for the lakeshore loop. The root-strewn trail along the western bank is only partially suitable for rough strollers; taking the wider paved lane through Piburg to the bathing area is recommended for families with prams.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via motorway A12 (exit Ötztal) and take highway B186 into Oetz, following the paved mountain spur road up to the hamlet of Piburg, where paid parking is designated. Train travelers alight at Ötztal Bahnhof and transfer to regional buses to Oetz center, from where scenic footpaths ascend to the lake.

Tipps

Rent a classic wooden rowing boat at the lakeside lido and glide silently across the tranquil surface reflecting the sharp rocky summit of Mount Acherkogel. Afterwards, savor homemade fruit dumplings on the lakeside terrace of Restaurant Piburger See.
